card.name: Source language in word origins
card.fires_on: The name of a source language (Latin, Greek, French, L.) or the word "from" in a dictionary etymology, right before the original foreign word is given.

modes.label: Language name before root
modes.description: A language name such as Latin, Greek or Middle French follows "from the" and comes just before the root word.
modes.example: It derives from the<< Latin>> mille, thousand, and annus

modes.label: Abbreviated or linking form
modes.description: An abbreviation like L. or a linking word like "from" in an etymology note sits just before the foreign root.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, but it hints at a foreign-language word coming next.
